data.name: Auth0 Authorization server
data.description: Identity provider providing OAuth 2.0, OIDC, MFA, SSO

threats.title: Credential Theft
threats.description: Attacker steals valid session cookies or login credentials to impersonate legitimate human user.
threats.mitigation: Enforce MFA and WebAuthn via Auth0 with Universal Login, adaptive brute-force protection, and IP throttling.

threats.title: Token Theft & Replay Attack
threats.description: Stolen bearer access tokens replayed across backend services without client binding.
threats.mitigation: Implement ephemeral short-lived access tokens, and cryptographic token binding.

threats.title: Authorization Scope Escalation
threats.description: Manipulating M2M token request scope parameters to acquire unauthorized administrative API scopes.
threats.mitigation: Apply rigid RBAC/ABAC role validation and Zero-Trust continuous scope evaluation.
